Per-call API prices (x402)

A few machine endpoints answer an unpaid request with HTTP 402 and an x402 payment request, paid in USDC on Base. These are the paths the Cloudflare gateway charges, generated from the estate's canonical price catalog. Prices as of 2026-11-13 22:49 UTC. Machine-readable copy: /.well-known/x402-pricing.json.

Owner policy (2026-11-06). Charge API and MCP hosts only. Websites, /pricing, the proof site a11oy.net, health checks and /.well-known paths stay free. Limits. Methods: the completions/responses rule explicitly excludes OPTIONS for browser preflight. Other rules export no HTTP method selection, and whether POST requests to these paths are charged is unverified. Origins: paying clears the gateway only; whether each origin then serves a paid caller without its own credential has not been verified. Eligibility: Cloudflare's Monetization Gateway requires buyers and sellers to be based in the United States. Revenue: this catalog records prices, not settlements; it says nothing about whether any payment has settled.
